name: com.myvisawatcher/visa-watcher
title: Visa Watcher
description: Live US visa appointment availability in Brazil, Colombia and Mexico: earliest dates, wait times

tools.name: get_visa_appointment_availability
tools.description:
Open US visa appointment dates right now in Brazil, Colombia or Mexico
("tem vaga para o visto americano?", "¿hay citas para la visa americana?"):
the earliest date per consulate city and how many dates are listed, as last
seen on the official site. city: any covered city (it sets the country):
Brazil: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brasília, Recife, Porto Alegre; Colombia:
Bogotá; Mexico: Ciudad de México, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Tijuana, Ciudad
Juárez, Hermosillo, Matamoros, Mérida, Nogales, Nuevo Laredo. Empty for every
city of the country. country: 'br' (default), 'co' or 'mx'. kind: 'interview'
or 'casv_renewal' (renewals that only need the CASV/CAS); empty for both.

tools.name: get_new_dates_patterns
tools.description:
When new US visa appointment dates appear in Brazil, Colombia or Mexico and
how fast they are booked: busiest hours and weekdays (the country's local
time), how long a date stays open, how far ahead new dates are. Statistics
over the last 30 days, for one city or every city of a country. city: any
covered city (it sets the country); country: 'br' (default), 'co' or 'mx'.
Use for "que horas abrem vagas?", "¿a qué hora salen citas?", "when should I
check?" or "how fast do dates go?".

tools.name: get_wait_time_history
tools.description:
How long the wait for a US visa appointment is in one city of Brazil,
Colombia or Mexico and how it changed over the last 90 days: the earliest
open date each day and how many days away it was, plus the earliest date
right now. city: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brasília, Recife, Porto Alegre,
Bogotá, Ciudad de México, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Tijuana, Ciudad Juárez,
Hermosillo, Matamoros, Mérida, Nogales or Nuevo Laredo.

tools.name: how_visa_watcher_works
tools.description:
What Visa Watcher is: who it is for, how it books a US visa interview in
Brazil, Colombia or Mexico, the price and the refund guarantee. Use when
someone asks for help getting (or moving up) a US visa appointment in one of
those countries. country: 'br', 'co' or 'mx' for one country; empty for all
three.
